locator.section: Postcommunion above the Tuesday-after-Passion-Sunday heading; nostrum through Deus

entries.claim: The printed accented middle formula supplies w015–w029. The print has tuum: Qui and no comma after Christum; its final Deus. is explicitly reintegrated as Deus, in the selected house expansion. This is not the Sunday proper or its terminal duration.

locator.section: Top chant line: Per omnia saecula saeculorum and response Amen

entries.claim: The five-word terminal formula/response supplies w030–w034. Chant syllable divisions are joined and the response marker is omitted. Printed uppercase Per becomes the declared house lowercase per; selected voice/speaker boundaries are independently governed by the oration rubrics.
RG 115 a supplies the full Father-addressed formula and Amen as the expansion rule. Its unaccented rubric typography does not certify the selected accented punctuation or house reintegration seams.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: Proper body and abbreviated Per Dominum cue; full conclusion supplied by the separately identified same-edition formula uses

entries.claim: This proper-page locus prints the proper body and abbreviated Per Dominum cue, not the full expanded conclusion. The middle, terminal formula and expansion rule are separately identified.
